claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule splashed down safely in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion capsule splashed down at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The crew landed about 40 to 50 miles off the San Diego coast.
Retrieval was handled by U.S. Navy teams.
The splashdown occurred on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The crew was transported to the USS John P. Murtha following extraction.
The crew consisted of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The capsule was recovered by NASA and Navy teams.
The crew was scheduled to be flown to the ship via helicopter for initial medical evaluations.
The crew was scheduled to return to shore for transport to Houston.
